questions.question: What is the history of Fumiko Mifune?
questions.subject: Fumiko Mifune/History

answer.item: At the age of 14, Fumiko made a contract with the STD Devil, which allowed her to overwrite anyone who engaged in sexual intercourse with her, turning them into a perfect duplicate of herself and linking them into a shared hivemind.
